verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform issues API credentials for machine access. Developers register an account, form a team, get sandbox access, and receive production keys after passing a demo. The exposed APIs are narrow (case status, FOIA request/status), but the evidence never shows any way to choose scopes, permissions, or per-agent restrictions when issuing keys. missing for 10: user-selectable scopes or permission granularity on keys, per-agent or least-privilege credential issuance, self-serve key rotation/revocation, documentation of credential scoping, independent corroboration.
